claims.statement: Thomas Bascom of Marysville, Tennessee, offered to bet Tom Allen $10,000 that he could beat him inside eight rounds.
claims.excerpt: i propose, further, to bet Tom Allen $10,000

claims.statement: Thomas Bascom offered to bet Tom Allen, or any other man, $5,000 or more that Charley Gallagher, after two hours' training with Bascom, could whip his opponent inside twenty rounds.
claims.excerpt: I will bet Tom Allen, orany other man, any

notes: Mock wagers in a letter from Bascom to the New York Sun, reprinted here; no match was made. Only the bets naming Allen are recorded.
